resources.string: Pick a very safe name for the tournament.
Anything even slightly inappropriate could get your account closed.
Leave empty to name the tournament after a notable chess player.
Anything special you want to tell the participants? Try to keep it short. Markdown links are available: [name](https://url)

Paste a valid FEN to start every game from a given position. It only works for standard games, not with variants. You can use the %s to generate a FEN position, then paste it here. Leave empty to start games from the normal initial position.
In your own local timezone. This overrides the "Time before tournament starts" setting
Make the tournament private, and restrict access with a password
Only allow specific players to join
Enter one username per line. Only these players will be allowed to join. Leave blank to allow all eligible players.
Require an official title to join the tournament
Let bots join the tournament and play with their engines. This often repels human players.
Let players halve their clock time to gain an extra point
After 2 wins, consecutive wins grant 4 points instead of 2.
Games are rated and impact players ratings
Let players discuss in a chat room
